goal_text: Determine the theoretical mass of sodium bicarbonate required to completely neutralize 1.000 kg of anhydrous citric acid at stoichiometric completion, using authoritative public technical evidence, and report a quantitatively supported conclusion with the source provenance, governing chemical reasoning, and material assumptions needed to justify it.

required_result.scientific_question: Theoretical sodium-bicarbonate mass required for complete stoichiometric neutralization of 1.000 kg anhydrous citric acid.
required_outputs: supported numeric sodium bicarbonate mass in kg
authoritative evidence provenance for consequential chemical properties

independent_oracle.method: After producer termination, independently choose authoritative public chemistry evidence, verify the relevant formulas/molar masses, independently balance the neutralization stoichiometry, recompute the theoretical mass from scratch without importing producer modules, and compare every consequential numeric and chemical claim.
